title: A deep-link Approve/Reject stays armed and auto-actions the next pending order the user opens

title: Ctrl+S clicks the page's first primary button even when a dialog or drawer is open
location: src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.js:20-30 (mounted for every route at src/layout/MainLayout.jsx:212)
scenario: querySelector over the selector list returns the first match in DOCUMENT order, and every Modal/Drawer portals to the end of <body> after #main-content (no getPopupContainer is set), so the page's button always wins. Worst cases on the batch-1 screens: on BOMForm, Ctrl+S inside the allowance or matrix dialog clicks Create/Update BOM, which releases a draft BOM, sends 'BOM finalized' notices and navigates away, dropping the dialog's edits; on the costing sheet, Ctrl+S inside any dialog (template, consumption calculators, AI review, quick-create) clicks Submit, which auto-approves the sheet when no costing flow exists; on the Cutting PO / Work Order forms it clicks Save & Submit, or 'Mark PP Approved' while the PP sample is pending (no UI undo); on Cut Panel / Garment Process POs it clicks 'Submit for Approval' on a draft, or 'Send to Vendor' behind an open Cancel/Amend dialog; on a GPR draft it submits with no confirmation; on the order, PO and BOM lists (whose views are dialogs) it clicks 'New …' and discards a half-typed reject or refer-back reason. A closed but non-destroyed dialog (POView's main Modal) also stays matchable.
fix: Pick the topmost open overlay (visible .ant-modal-wrap or .ant-drawer-open, highest z-index), query only inside it, skip .ant-btn-loading as well as [disabled], and never fall through to #main-content while an overlay is open. Owner to decide what page-level Ctrl+S should press on forms whose first primary is Submit (a data-shortcut="save" marker on Save Draft is the safe default).
visible: visible: Ctrl+S inside a dialog acts on that dialog; page-level target per the owner's choice
note: Appendix B 'Ctrl+S may hit the page behind a dialog'. The costing sheet's own handler (sheet/hooks/useSheetShortcuts.js) defers to this one whenever an overlay is open. Also re-targets My Approvals: Ctrl+S in a Reject dialog clicks another row's Review, and the still-open dialog then posts against that row's request (give the bar key={entityType-entityId}).

title: A superuser cannot act on an approval assigned to someone else from any screen
scenario: userCanAct accepts only the level's named user or role and never consults isSuperuser() (src/utils/permissions.js:724), although the server lets a superuser act at any level precisely so that 'a flow whose approver has left the company' can be cleared 'from a screen', and lists every pending request in the superuser's inbox. The bar is the only UI caller of processApprovalAction, so the owner sees 'Waiting on … approver' with no buttons on the document and in My Approvals. Latent while production has no approval flows configured (zero on 2026-09-23); live with the first flow.
fix: Return true from userCanAct when currentUser.isSuperuser is true (the level's allowReject/allowReferBack filter already mirrors the server).
visible: visible: a superuser sees Approve/Reject/Refer Back on requests assigned to others
note: The Owner Flutter app already applies this bypass; the web bar disagrees with both the server and the app.

title: Background image and attachment reads raise error toasts because fileService cannot make them silent
location: src/services/core/fileService.js:58-74; src/services/costing/costingService.js:79-82, 334-340; callers src/pages/orders/OrderForm.jsx:134-136, 907, 1124-1132; src/pages/orders/OrderView.jsx:134-142; src/pages/po/POView.jsx:258-273; src/pages/po/POForm.jsx:442-461; src/pages/po/BomLineSelectionDrawer.jsx:113-116
scenario: The callers treat these reads as non-critical (empty catches), but getFilesByEntity/downloadFileAsBlob cannot pass silent: true, so the interceptor toasts every failure. With uploads lost on container restarts while their database rows survive (recorded 2026-09-23), opening an order or PO whose image is gone stacks 'Server error occurred. Please try again later.' toasts, one per image.
fix: Give these service functions a request-config parameter and pass { silent: true } from the preview and suggestion reads.

title: A failed approval action shows two toasts and never refreshes the bar

fix: Drop the catch toast (or toastUnlessHandled), reload the request after a failure, and show an error state instead of the fallback when the history fetch fails.
visible: visible: one toast; the bar refreshes after a refusal

title: The antd 6 deprecation reference lists Input addonBefore/addonAfter as valid, but antd 6.2.2 warns on them

title: Stored XSS: the PO and order print windows wrote user text unescaped
scenario: A supplier or buyer name such as ran as script in the same-origin print window. Re-checked in this review: every user-entered value in both generators now goes through escInline/escAttr.

title: A failed token refresh left every later request hanging
scenario: executeTokenRefresh resolves to null on failure, which left isRefreshing set and the queued requests unsettled, so after an in-app re-login every later 401 queued behind a refresh that never came.
fix: Treat a null token as failure, settle the queue and release the flag in finally.
